is_run_record: None of this was a run record: nothing was under runs/, data/, ledgers/, reports/ or artifacts/, no run id existed, and no simulation had been run for a result. Stated plainly, though: provision.log and provision2.log were evidence. They were the only direct record of the first setup failure and of the runaway, and they are lost. The cause in this record rests on what the agent saw before the crash, in this session's transcript.
